value.rationale: A sharp all-aspect-ratio global angular stability inequality for ellipse Minkowski sums, with strict complete monotonicity of derivatives and the optimal explicit strong-concavity modulus, strengthens an important classical excluded-area orientation result. The strengthened shape-order control is not a routine reparameterization of the known monotonic statement.
